name: Revive Buried/Disappeared Villagers
description: **Needs Story / Cheat Upgrades** (it adds to that row's Tech-screen upgrades). A new upgrade in the Tech screen's upgrades menu, "Revive Buried/Disappeared Villagers", which costs 100,000 tech points each time while Story / Cheat Upgrades cost Tech Points is ticked and nothing while it is unticked, like the other story upgrades. It lists every buried villager and every villager who vanished, from the village's own Deaths and Disappearances log, with their name, sex, age at death, cause of death or what happened, grave line and epitaph, likes and dislikes, head and body, parents, mask, custom title and special title, and their skills from the last Village History snapshot of them; anything the logs do not hold is shown as unknown. The one you pick comes back as the same person, aged 5, through the game's own villager creator, and their grave is removed. **Every detail (v1.35.101): when a villager dies or disappears, by any path, the Cause of Death row now keeps their complete record - every field the game's own save keeps of them - and what the patcher's files keep for them (head look, gender presentation, mask, story traits, A New Home's parents), in its own file per save slot; the revived villager gets all of it back: name and last name, sex, looks and personal number, family, parents, likes, dislikes, every skill with its fractions, job preference and titles. Only the age (5), health, sickness, a pregnancy and what they were doing start fresh.** A death from before v1.35.101 comes back from the logs (name and last name, sex, parents, likes and dislikes, looks, mask, custom title, and skills from the last Village History snapshot), and the list says which. It can be bought again and again. **Refused, with nothing charged, while the village is at its maximum population or has fewer tech points than it costs.** **The list comes from the logs: villagers are listed only when "Write Births and Conceptions Log to Text File" and "Show Cause of Death and Epitaphs on Graves, and Log Every Death" logged their death or disappearance (without them the list is empty), and their skills are known only with a Village History snapshot of them.** A villager in the village now is never listed. A Heathen whose death or disappearance the logs record ("Faction: Heathen") is listed and comes back as a Heathen in the camp, through the game's own Heathen creator, with their Faith, masks and every other detail. New Believers' puzzle Heathens (the Heathen Doctor, the Heathen Chief, the three Masters and the Heathen Mommy; the owner, 2026-11-26) come back in their own role and mask, set up as the game sets that role up and at the role's own age (the Doctor and the Mommy 20 years, the Masters 27, the Chief 50), so the role works - the Chief with every skill 100, the Mommy with her infant by a living adult Heathen of the camp, never "Unknown" - or as an ordinary Heathen, with every other detail, when a living Heathen holds that role now, its puzzle is solved, or (the Mommy) no other adult Heathen lives. A believer who left to become a Heathen is listed as alive among the Heathens. A Heathen buried at the mud hut ("VVFP Heathen Mausoleum.dll") is found there and their grave is taken away through that companion. Heathens come back as Heathens even after The Last Heathen is solved. The returned villager gets an "Arrived" record (How: Returned from the dead) in the Births and Conceptions log at the next save; nothing is counted as a birth or a death. Off by default; on in Owner's Defaults.
behavior_changes: "VVFP Story Upgrades.dll" offers the upgrade while "VVFP Revive From Graves.txt" is in the patcher's folder (its contents are never read); the Origins companion adds the Tech menu's button last, above its other story buttons, as wide as its label needs.

The list: every "Death <n>" and "Disappeared" record of this save slot's Deaths and Disappearances logs (both folder layouts), the newest record of each person (name, sex, head, body, likes, dislikes); the skills from the newest Village History snapshot of the same name, sex, head and body no older than at death.

The revival: the game's own creator (through the Custom Island Event's spawn: the game's own room predicate and a free record first) at age 100 (5 years), then the name, head, body, every like and dislike the record holds room for, the skills, the parents (A New Home: with Show Parents in Details Screen), the custom title and the mask.

Every detail (v1.35.101): "VVFP Cause of Death.dll" keeps each departing villager's saved record fields (native/shared/revive_snapshot.h, the windows each game's own save writer and loader keep) and the patcher files' head look, gender presentation, mask, story traits and A New Home's parents, at the moment the game frees the record, and adds them at the next save to "Revive Snapshots\Virtual Villagers N Revive Snapshots - Save S.dat" in the save's own folder (never the save). Each log record is matched to its snapshot by name, sex, head, body, age at death, likes and dislikes; two different snapshots that could be the same person are never guessed between. The revival writes every persistent field onto the record the game's creator made, all or none, read back and checked; any difference and the record is the creator's again and the villager comes back from the logs.

The grave (New Believers): the mausoleum's Roster of the Dead (0x5481A8, 500 entries of 0x5C): as The Tree of Life. Matched by name and age at death and the head and body, each grave to one record in log order; a grave that changed since the list was made is never removed (the purchase is refused).

With Story / Cheat Upgrades cost Tech Points ticked, 100,000 tech points are taken only once the villager is back (free with it unticked); with fewer the purchase is refused, so the tech points never go below 0.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the row's only file is its flag.

Nothing is counted as a birth or a death, and the game's own statistics are not touched; the logs are append-only, so the old Death or Disappeared record stays and the Arrived record says they returned.
A body awaiting burial is not listed (Custom Island Event's Revive brings bodies back).
evidence_status: emulated: the list from log texts, the refusals, the purchase through each game's own creator in all three population modes, the grave's removal and the game's own grave counts afterwards (tests/test_story_revive_from_graves.py); runtime/player confirmation pending
